claim: FL's EU consumer terms were re-issued with 'Last Modification Date: 1 July 2026'. Annex I (seller entities) drops Denmark, Norway and Sweden (and, on the .co.uk version, Switzerland), which were still listed in the 1-Apr-2026 version. All 14 owned EU markets keep their seller entities, and the footlocker.eu country selector now carries an 'Operated by License Partner: Greece, Romania, Bulgaria' block that was not on the Apr-2026 capture. No new country-level web or legal withdrawal has happened since the deal.
data_point: Annex I live (co.uk): AT, BE, CZ, FR, DE, HU, IE, IT, LU, PL, PT, ES, NL, UK (14). .de version also lists CH (15). Apr-2026 co.uk version: those plus DK, NO, SE, CH (18). The Apr-2026 co.uk version gave FL Poland's address as Plac Trzech Krzyzy 10/14 (Ethos Building); the live co.uk version shows ul. Bielanska 12 again. UK seller: Freedom Sportsline Ltd (1779106). Main establishment: FL Europe B.V., KvK 23067735.
source_name: Foot Locker EU terms and conditions (live and Wayback); footlocker.eu country selector
original_quote: Last Modification Date: 1 July 2026 ANNEX I List of Foot Locker entities
english_translation: n/a (English original); DE: 'Letzte Aenderung: 1. Juli 2026'; IT: 'Ultimo aggiornamento: 1 luglio 2026'
verifier_note: Verifier re-fetched the live co.uk/de/it terms and the 2026-04-01 Wayback copy on 2026-10-07 and parsed the Annex I country lists: DK/NO/SE are present in Apr-2026 and absent now. Switzerland is still on the .de version. Correction: the Poland address on the live co.uk version is back to Bielanska 12, so the 'office move' is inconsistent across versions. The live footlocker.eu shows the 'Operated by License Partner Greece Romania Bulgaria' block; the Wayback capture nearest 2026-04-10 does not. Nordic exits are KNOWN (baseline); the novel part is the dated legal clean-up and the absence of any new country withdrawal. Downgraded A->B because it is negative (absence) evidence.

claim: FL Europe runs a two-tier digital estate. The FLX loyalty programme and the iOS app are available only in the UK, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands and Spain. The 8 tail markets (BE, AT, PT, PL, IE, CZ, HU, LU, about 69 locator stores or ~12% of the European fleet) have neither, even though the Jul-2025 PR announced a FLX launch 'across Europe'. INFERENCE: this is a ready-made perimeter for licensing or exit.
data_point: iTunes lookup id934030757 (v9.13.2, released 2026-10-01): resultCount 1 in GB/FR/DE/IT/ES/NL and 0 in BE/AT/PT/PL/IE/CZ/HU/LU. Site config 'loyaltyEnabled': true on co.uk/fr/de, false on be/at/pl/ie/hu (verifier sample). The help-centre FLX article lists 6 countries. Tail store counts per the confirmed locator census: BE 15, PL 12, PT 9-11, CZ 9-10, AT 6, LU 6, IE 5, HU 4.
source_name: help.footlocker.eu; Apple iTunes lookup API; footlocker.<tld> page config
original_quote: FLX Membership is currently available in: the UK, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, and Spain.
verifier_note: Verifier reproduced on 2026-10-07: the FLX help text, iTunes availability across all 14 storefronts, and the loyaltyEnabled flags on 8 sites. Per the scraper the structure pre-dates the deal (flags were false on Wayback Jun/Nov-2025), so it is a standing two-tier design rather than a post-deal change. The carve-out reading is inference, so tier B, not A. The per-country store counts duplicate C_w1_labor-rest #3.

claim: APAC hidden closures: 8 ANZ store pages (7 AU, 1 NZ) are still on FL's locator but show 'closed' all 7 days: Bondi Junction Westfield, Castle Towers, Murarrie Metroplex, Southport Australia Fair, Westfield Doncaster, Morley Galleria, Chadstone secondary unit (id 88700) and NZ Westfield Glenfield. Landlord directories confirm FL has left Bondi Junction, a major Sydney mall. Locator-based APAC counts overstate trading stores.
data_point: 8 of ~104 ANZ locator pages carry schema.org openingHours 'Su closed Mo closed ... Sa closed'. The Westfield Bondi Junction directory (295 store slugs over all pages, fetched 2026-10-07) has no Foot Locker; JD Sports is listed. Implied ANZ trading: about 96 vs 104 listed (92 APAC owned at 8/1/26 per the 10-Q).
source_name: stores.footlocker.com.au / .co.nz store pages; Westfield Bondi Junction store directory
original_quote: openingHours: Su closed Mo closed Tu closed We closed Th closed Fr closed Sa closed
verifier_note: Verifier re-fetched all 8 pages on 2026-10-07: all show 7/7 closed. Correction: Chadstone 24_88700 is a secondary 'Shop B047' page; the main Chadstone B149 store (94773) is trading, so this is NOT a Chadstone flagship closure. Bondi Junction is corroborated by its absence from the Westfield directory. Others could be refits (E_w1_apac-asia #5 shows a scheduled refit wave in Oct-2026). The European half of this scraper finding (Avignon, Lyon, Aulnay, Ulm, Czestochowa) DUPLICATES D_w1_gmaps-closed #2 and D_w1_landlords-malls #3 and is excluded here. The parallel E_w1_apac-au-nz raw has the same ANZ result, not yet in confirmed.

claim: The pan-EU online release calendar is thinner y/y. The verifier's recount: 72 launches in the live Sep-10 to Nov-1-2026 calendar vs 81 in the Sep-15 to Nov-8-2025 capture (-11%). Nike+Jordan 29 vs 38 (-24%), adidas 10 vs 20. The calendar is identical on .de and .co.uk.
data_point: Live 2026-10-07: Nike 20, adidas 10, New Balance 9, Jordan 9, Vans 7, Puma 7 (72). Wayback 2025-10-11: Nike 27, adidas 20, Jordan 11, Mizuno 9, Puma 6 (81). The scraper reported 49 vs 58 and Nike+Jordan 18 vs 25.
verifier_note: Direction reproduced, but the scraper's exact counts were not (different windowing or dedup). One snapshot per year, and listings are not volumes. Nike said on 2026-10-01 it is cutting Jordan retro launch volume and frequency industry-wide (D_w1_sector-backdrop #8), so this is not FL-specific. Downgraded B->C.

claim: Online assortment depth on FL EU sites (brand-page product counts) shows no sign of Nike or adidas pulling FL Europe a year after the deal: UK Nike 1,956, UK adidas 2,118, FR Nike 1,949, FR adidas 2,394 on 2026-10-07. Jordan has thinned: DE Jordan 824 (13-Nov-2025) -> 522. adidas depth on the tail-market sites is about 1/3 of core (BE 753).
data_point: Live totalResults on 2026-10-07: UK Nike 1,956 (scraper 2,041), UK adidas 2,118, UK Jordan 553, FR Nike 1,949, FR adidas 2,394, DE Jordan 522 (scraper 549), BE adidas 753. Wayback DE Jordan 824 (2025-11-13) verified.
source_name: FL EU brand category pages + Wayback
verifier_note: Live counts reproduced (close to the scraper's numbers). The y/y baselines for UK Nike/adidas (Sep-2025) and FR Nike/adidas (Sep/Oct-2025) could NOT be reproduced: those Wayback captures contain no totalResults field. Only DE Jordan's y/y fall is verified. Counts mix colourways, sizes and sale items, so they are noisy. Downgraded B->C.
